key_insight: A scenario-free bilevel DLMP framework coordinates EV active/reactive charging to cut costs while keeping distribution voltages secure under uncertain load and PV generation.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical control-and-pricing strategy for distribution operators to manage EV growth and voltage support with lower computational burden than stochastic or conventional robust methods.
method: Upper level: EV aggregator schedules active and reactive charging to minimize charging cost.
Lower level: network-constrained dispatch computes DLMPs while enforcing feeder and voltage limits.
Robust counterpart reformulates asymmetric net-demand uncertainty with a normal-minus-beta distribution into a deterministic problem.
evidence_signal: Validated on the IEEE 33-bus system, where the approach improved voltage security, coordinated EV charging effectively, and reduced computation versus stochastic and robust alternatives.
watch_item: The KKT/Big-M reformulation and DLMP exactness rely on modeling assumptions that may be sensitive to parameter tuning and implementation details in real distribution networks.
paper_title: Scenario-Free Uncertainty-Aware DLMP-Based Bilevel Coordination of EV Charging and Reactive Power Support in Distribution Networks
